metadata.question: Does the soil moisture in California increase in April 2017 compared to August 2012?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
- Dataset: Primary = ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/HOURLY (global hourly soil moisture, 1981–present). Fallback = NASA/GLDAS/V021/NOAH/G025/T3H for robustness.
- Location: California from TIGER/2018/States.
- Dates: April 2017 (2017-04-01 to 2017-05-01), August 2012 (2012-08-01 to 2012-09-01).

2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).
- Not applicable (reanalysis/gridded data; no clouds). Compute mean directly.

3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- Check image collection sizes; if 0 and fallback also 0 -> C1.
- Compute pixel counts via reduceRegion; if 0 -> C2.
- Validate means: must be finite and within [0, 1] for volumetric soil water. If invalid -> C3.
- Compare April 2017 mean - August 2012 mean; positive -> A, else -> B.
</thinking>

```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); // You must include this line

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const states = ee.FeatureCollection('TIGER/2018/States');
    const ca = states.filter(ee.Filter.eq('NAME', 'California')).geometry();
    const periodA = {label: 'Apr2017', start: '2017-04-01', end: '2017-05-01'};
    const periodB = {label: 'Aug2012', start: '2012-08-01', end: '2012-09-01'};

    // 2. Helper to get stats from a dataset (with fallback)
    async function getSoilMoistureStats(region, start, end) {
      // Primary: ERA5-Land (hourly)
      let dataset = 'ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/HOURLY';
      let band = 'volumetric_soil_water_layer_1';
      let scale = 9000;
      let col = ee.ImageCollection(dataset)
        .filterDate(start, end)
        .filterBounds(region)
        .select([band]);
      let imgCount = await col.size().getInfo();
      if (imgCount === 0) {
        // Fallback: GLDAS NOAH V2.1 3-hourly
        dataset = 'NASA/GLDAS/V021/NOAH/G025/T3H';
        band = 'SoilMoi0_10cm_inst';
        scale = 25000;
        col = ee.ImageCollection(dataset)
          .filterDate(start, end)
          .filterBounds(region)
          .select([band]);
        imgCount = await col.size().getInfo();
        if (imgCount === 0) {
          return {imgCount: 0, count: 0, mean: null, dataset, band, scale};
        }
      }

      const imgMean = col.mean();
      const reducer = ee.Reducer.mean().combine({
        reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(),
        sharedInputs: true
      });
      const stats = await imgMean.reduceRegion({
        reducer: reducer,
        geometry: region,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9,
        tileScale: 4
      }).getInfo();

      const meanKey = Object.keys(stats).find(k => k.endsWith('_mean'));
      const countKey = Object.keys(stats).find(k => k.endsWith('_count'));
      const mean = meanKey ? stats[meanKey] : null;
      const count = countKey ? stats[countKey] : 0;

      return {imgCount, count, mean, dataset, band, scale};
    }

    // 3. Acquire stats for both periods
    const a = await getSoilMoistureStats(ca, periodA.start, periodA.end);
    const b = await getSoilMoistureStats(ca, periodB.start, periodB.end);

    // 4. Checks for C1/C2
    if ((a.imgCount === 0) || (b.imgCount === 0)) {
      console.log(`Apr2017 Images: ${a.imgCount}`);
      console.log(`Aug2012 Images: ${b.imgCount}`);
      console.log('Result: Empty Collection for one or both periods.');
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }
    if ((a.count === 0) || (b.count === 0)) {
      console.log(`Apr2017 Images: ${a.imgCount}, Valid Pixels: ${a.count}`);
      console.log(`Aug2012 Images: ${b.imgCount}, Valid Pixels: ${b.count}`);
      console.log('Result: No valid pixels after processing.');
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    // 5. Validation for C3 (null/NaN/out-of-range)
    const isBad = (v) => v === null || v === undefined || !isFinite(v);
    if (isBad(a.mean) || isBad(b.mean)) {
      console.log(`Apr2017 Mean: ${a.mean}, Aug2012 Mean: ${b.mean}`);
      console.log('Result: Calculation failure (null/NaN).');
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }
    // If using ERA5-Land, expected volumetric 0..1. If fallback GLDAS used, band is surface soil moisture [kg/m^2], not bounded 0..1.
    // We only enforce 0..1 when dataset is ERA5-Land for both periods.
    const aIsERA5 = a.dataset === 'ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/HOURLY';
    const bIsERA5 = b.dataset === 'ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/HOURLY';
    if (aIsERA5 && (a.mean < 0 || a.mean > 1)) {
      console.log(`Apr2017 Mean out of range for ERA5: ${a.mean}`);
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }
    if (bIsERA5 && (b.mean < 0 || b.mean > 1)) {
      console.log(`Aug2012 Mean out of range for ERA5: ${b.mean}`);
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    // 6. Print concise evidence
    console.log(`Dataset Apr2017: ${a.dataset} [band=${a.band}, scale=${a.scale}m]`);
    console.log(`Dataset Aug2012: ${b.dataset} [band=${b.band}, scale=${b.scale}m]`);
    console.log(`Apr2017 Images: ${a.imgCount}`);
    console.log(`Aug2012 Images: ${b.imgCount}`);
    console.log(`Apr2017 Mean: ${a.mean !== null ? a.mean.toFixed(4) : 'null'}, Pixels: ${a.count}`);
    console.log(`Aug2012 Mean: ${b.mean !== null ? b.mean.toFixed(4) : 'null'}, Pixels: ${b.count}`);

    // 7. Compute difference and decide
    const diff = a.mean - b.mean;
    if (!isFinite(diff)) {
      console.log('Result: Difference invalid (NaN/Inf).');
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }
    console.log(`Diff (Apr2017 - Aug2012): ${diff.toFixed(4)}`);

    // Final tag
    if (diff > 0) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    // Catch any runtime errors (e.g., band names, memory, syntax) -> D
    const msg = (err && err.message) ? err.message : String(err);
    console.log(`Error: ${msg}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
